description:
After developing trauma from threats by antis, former idol Noah leaves his group and decides to start fresh as an actor. While preparing for his first supporting role, he goes to see a film by the drama’s director — and there, he encounters a strange man quietly crying in the theater.

Noah lends him a handkerchief, but when the man recognizes who he is, Noah’s trauma resurfaces and he bolts from the cinema. Soon after, at the drama’s production meeting, Noah comes face-to-face with that same man again — only to learn he’s the lead actor, Shin I-jun.

And then Shin I-jun smiles and says he’s Noah’s fan?!

**Original Webtoon:**
